description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans Observer pattern implementation, verifying observer registration, notification, subscription lifecycle, and cleanup behaviors within the Orleans framework. It uses the xUnit testing framework and references various Orleans components.

classes.name: ObserverTests
classes.description: Unit test suite for testing the Orleans Observer pattern implementation, including subscription management, callback invocation, and cleanup behaviors.

classes.name: SimpleGrainObserver
classes.description: Internal class implementing the ISimpleGrainObserver interface for testing observer callback invocation, wrapping an action and result callback with logging.

methods.name: TestInitialize
methods.description: Resets internal state before each test.

methods.name: GetGrain
methods.description: Retrieves a grain implementing ISimpleObserverableGrain using a random grain ID.

methods.name: ObserverTest_SimpleNotification
methods.description: Tests basic observer registration and notification delivery.

methods.name: ObserverTest_SimpleNotification_GeneratedFactory
methods.description: Tests observer notification using generated factory methods.

methods.name: ObserverTest_DoubleSubscriptionSameReference
methods.description: Verifies that duplicate subscriptions with the same observer reference are handled properly.

methods.name: ObserverTest_SubscribeUnsubscribe
methods.description: Verifies correct behavior of subscribing and unsubscribing observers.

methods.name: ObserverTest_Unsubscribe
methods.description: Tests the behavior when unsubscribing a non-subscribed observer.

methods.name: ObserverTest_DoubleSubscriptionDifferentReferences
methods.description: Tests multiple observers subscribing to the same grain.

methods.name: ObserverTest_DeleteObject
methods.description: Tests that deleting an observer reference stops further notifications.

methods.name: ObserverTest_SubscriberMustBeGrainReference
methods.description: Ensures that only grain references can be used as observers; otherwise, an exception is thrown.

methods.name: ObserverTest_CreateObjectReference_ThrowsForInvalidArgumentTypes
methods.description: Verifies that creating object references with invalid argument types throws exceptions.

methods.name: ObserverTest_DoubleSubscriptionDifferentReferences_Callback
methods.description: Callback invoked for multiple observer notifications, verifying correct invocation count.

methods.name: ObserverTest_SubscribeUnsubscribe_Callback
methods.description: Callback invoked during subscription test to verify notification behavior after unsubscribe.

methods.name: ObserverTest_DeleteObject_Callback
methods.description: Callback verifying notification count post object deletion.
